Availability and willingness to travel. The Electrical & Dry Utilities Revit Specialist is responsible for leading the development, coordination, and governance of advanced BIM models focused on electrical and dry utility systems within industrial and transportation infrastructure projects. The role requires electrical engineering knowledge, deep Revit modeling expertise, and the ability to ensure full compliance with BIM and electrical design standards across multidisciplinary teams. The position combines electrical design understanding with advanced BIM modeling, covering power distribution, cable routing, electrical infrastructure, and utility coordination. Experience in Middle East projects, including regional electrical standards and fast-track delivery, is considered a strong advantage. Ensure proper integration of electrical systems within federated, multi-discipline BIM environments. Coordinate closely with civil, structural, architectural, and MEP teams to resolve electrical interfaces, constructability, and routing challenges. Perform clash detection and coordination using Navisworks, ensuring optimized cable routing, equipment placement, and spatial coordination. 2. Ensure models comply with electrical design standards, utility regulations, and authority requirements. Support implementation of digital engineering workflows for electrical data and asset information. 3. Multidisciplinary Collaboration Act as the primary BIM and electrical modeling focal point across projects. Lead coordination meetings to resolve clashes, electrical routing conflicts, and design interface risks. Collaborate with project managers, electrical engineers, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery. 5. Technical Support and Digital Innovation Provide advanced technical support in Revit electrical modeling, BIM coordination, and digital engineering. Experience with Navisworks, AutoCAD, and BIM coordination tools. Strong understanding of electrical infrastructure, power distribution, and dry utilities systems. Familiarity with Middle East electrical standards, authority regulations, and fast-track project environments. Knowledge of ISO 19650, PAS 1192, and BIM execution planning.
